aim: Verify benchmark causal identifiability and real action-reward headroom, independently of any learned model or scientific first-use episodes.

analytic.exact_method: Exhaustive binomial enumeration over k=0..n; no random data or science seeds
analytic.zero_probe: identical observed history; choosing A from silence is not valid

mechanical.method: Run unchanged official NS-Gym Bridge.step on pinned source. Compare every action's true reward and public next_state to original source-derived expectation. Never consume future first-use cohorts.
mechanical.rng: One-hot deterministic; global numpy RandomState preserved/restored serially; no concurrent RNG claim
mechanical.leakage: No env.unwrapped or diagnostic info used by agent; checker may use published static map as independent expected label; no privileged information passed to policy

future.science: Not executed. Independent prereg and explicit authorization required before any learner model training/first use.
future.controls: Strong fully trained conventional change-point Bayes, recency4/8/16, tabular Beta, logistic, one-slot, shuffled negative, A-return versus B-stays under matched actions/data/compute, cold restore, complete end-to-end cost
future.warning: An oracle with known A/B likelihood and prior is privileged and is NOT evidence of superiority for a learned method.

limits: Official published Bridge map and short scripted action prefix; no unfamiliar causal physics
Transfer laws differ in probabilities, not topology or foundational representation
Analytic expectation is not observed empirical success nor paired confidence intervals
No native Yggdrasil, Wingless, Hybrid, FORGE or controller integration
